ceo.title: Company CEO
ceo.quote: Welcome to the Business Hub, where we believe in the power of individuals, ideas, and institutions to lead with innovation, excellence, and purpose. Our mission is simple yet profound – transforming potential into progress. From startups to established companies, we connect ambition with opportunity through mentorship, incubation, acceleration, and empowerment. We pride ourselves on building ecosystems that enable growth and collaboration at every stage of the entrepreneurial journey. Our work extends to co-working spaces, training programs, and national initiatives that translate vision into measurable impact. We firmly believe in the leadership potential of Saudi Arabia and are committed to shaping an economy that not only competes globally but also leads. Yousef Albaladi, CEO, Business Hub
ceo.bio: A visionary leader with over 15 years’ experience supporting and empowering startups. Under his leadership, Business Hub helped more than 500 projects to grow and thrive.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: We are committed to protecting your privacy and the security of your personal information

sections.title: Information Collection
sections.content: We collect information that you provide directly to us when registering or using our services, including name, email, phone number, and information related to your project. We also automatically collect information about your use of the site such as IP address, browser type, and browsing history to improve your experience.

sections.title: Use of Information
sections.content: We use the collected information to provide and improve our services, communicate with you about our programs and events, process your requests and transactions, and personalize your experience on our platform. We may also use the information for analytical purposes and developing new services that meet your needs.

sections.title: Information Protection
sections.content: We take strict security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access or misuse. We use advanced encryption technologies, firewalls, and continuous monitoring systems. Your data is stored on secure servers and accessed only by authorized personnel.

sections.title: Information Sharing
sections.content: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information with trusted partners who help us provide our services, or when legally required. All third parties are obligated to protect your information and maintain its confidentiality according to the highest standards.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access your personal information, request its correction or deletion, object to its processing, and request data portability. You can also withdraw your consent to data processing at any time. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us through available communication channels.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.content: We use cookies to enhance your experience on our site, remember your preferences, and analyze site usage. You can control cookie settings through your browser, but disabling them may affect some site functionalities.

hero.title: How Can We Help You?
hero.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about our services and programs

items.question: What is the incubation service you offer?
items.answer: We offer a comprehensive incubation program that includes mentorship, training, consulting, workspace, and access to a wide network of investors and partners. We help entrepreneurs turn their ideas into successful projects through integrated support.

items.question: What is the duration of the incubation program?
items.answer: The incubation program duration ranges from 6 to 18 months, depending on the project nature and needs. We offer flexible programs that can be customized for each project.

items.question: What are the admission requirements for the incubation program?
items.answer: We look for innovative ideas with significant growth potential. You should have a clear idea, a committed team, and readiness to work hard. We evaluate projects based on innovation, market viability, and scalability.

items.question: What is the difference between incubation and acceleration?
items.answer: The incubation program targets projects in early stages (idea and prototype), while the acceleration program targets startups with a ready product seeking rapid growth and expansion.

items.question: How long is the acceleration program?
items.answer: The acceleration program typically lasts 3 to 6 months and is designed with high intensity to help achieve rapid and significant growth.

items.question: Do you take equity from the startup?
items.answer: This varies by program. Some programs are completely free, while others require a small equity stake in exchange for investment and support. We discuss details during the application process.

items.question: What types of workspaces are available?
items.answer: We provide shared workspaces, small private offices, large corporate offices, and virtual offices. All are equipped with the latest technology and integrated services.

items.question: Can I access the office at any time?
items.answer: Yes, we provide 24/7 access for all subscribers in private office packages. Shared spaces are available from 8 AM to 10 PM.

items.question: How long does the ISO certification process take?
items.answer: The process typically takes 3 to 6 months, depending on the company's readiness and commitment to implementing required standards.

items.question: What is the cost of obtaining ISO certification?
items.answer: Cost varies based on certification type, company size, and number of employees. We offer a free consultation to assess your needs and provide a customized quote.

items.question: Do you provide funding for projects?
items.answer: Yes, we provide direct funding for selected projects, and we also help connect entrepreneurs with a wide network of investors and investment funds.

items.question: How can I apply to join your programs?
items.answer: You can apply through our website by filling out the application form. Our team will review your application and contact you within 5-7 business days.

items.question: Do you offer consulting services?
items.answer: Yes, we offer comprehensive consulting services in business development, marketing, financial planning, operations management, and digital transformation.
